conceptZh: 科學家老鼠按下燒杯的按鈕，三滴水點先蹦出來，再有一個盒子彈出一朵浪花，浪花帶著一堆泡泡把「浪」的筆畫沖到位。
object: a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat, bubbling glass beakers and a spring-loaded jack-in-the-box full of foamy blue water
morph: three water drops and a good-sized crest of foam burst out of a box and wash the strokes of 浪 into place
creativeAngle: 驚喜彈出：用彈簧盒裡彈出的浪花帶出氵部與「良」，實驗室燒杯跟著冒泡，老鼠被嚇一跳後得意地在旁邊跳舞。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy with a locked frontal camera, bright and warm, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale butter-yellow lab bench backdrop with a few bubbling beakers lined up at the bottom edge. The only on-screen text is one bold, saturated ocean-blue Traditional Chinese glyph 浪, built as three water-drop strokes on the left (the water radical) beside the 良 component on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with generous margins. The lead is a bespectacled cartoon lab mouse in a tiny white coat with round glasses, an original character, no real people. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the mouse tiptoes in carrying a clipboard, pats a red spring-loaded jack-in-the-box, and the lid slams open; three round blue water drops shoot out one after another and stack down the left side as the water radical, while the first spoken 浪 lands as the box pops. Moment two (1.8-3.6s): the mouse does a huge double-take, glasses sliding down his nose, then a second beaker next to him fizzes over and the right-hand 良 slides in on a little tide of foam, each stroke clicking into place exactly as the second 浪 is spoken. Moment three (3.6-5.0s): a fat curling crest of soft foam bubbles bursts out of the box, the mouse hops onto a floating bubble and rides it in a loop, and the word 浪花 is spoken the moment the foam flower blooms and a little bubble pops on his nose. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 浪 is completely still, unobstructed and crisp in blue; the mouse sits on the bench far from the strokes, polishing his glasses with a happy wiggle, a single bubble drifting slowly past. Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「浪、浪、浪花」, read as ㄌㄤˋ、ㄌㄤˋ、ㄌㄤˋ ㄏㄨㄚ, first utterance at about 0.6s, second at about 2.7s, the word at about 4.4s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft pops and fizz under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter, no real people.

conceptZh: 浣熊花生抱著三桶水，助跑後趴地像保齡球一樣滑過濕滑地板，水桶飛出去濕成左邊三點水，撞倒排成一列的積木小隊，積木翻滾堆成右邊的「良」，花生跳起來敬禮，一道小海浪從腳下捲過。
object: three blue toy water buckets stacked too tall, a row of glossy ocean-blue building bricks standing like bowling pins, and a slick wet floor
morph: the buckets fly off and splash down as the three water-drop strokes on the left; the bricks topple, spin and stack into the 良 component on the right; the slide trail curls into a toy wave at the bottom margin
creativeAngle: 相較前版靜態的「浪慢慢捲高」與老鼠按盒子，這版是全程大動作的肚皮滑行保齡球：花生的招牌「錯時敬禮」害水桶差點倒成為第一次失誤，助跑滑行直接把水桶甩成三點水、撞散積木小隊堆成「良」，撞擊本身就是造字過程；「海浪」一詞由滑行水痕捲成的小浪具象呈現，聲畫一致。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second animated slapstick clip, locked frontal camera, bright warm daylight, no flashing. Setting: a clean solid pale sand-cream backdrop with a glossy, slightly wet pale-aqua floor that reads as slippery. Only on-screen text is ONE correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 浪 in saturated deep ocean blue, built from the three water-drop strokes of the 氵 radical on the left and the 良 component on the right, centered, uncropped, filling about 70% of frame height with clear margins. Lead: Peanut, an original cartoon raccoon sidekick with a striped tail, big eager eyes and a tiny cap, who always carries a stack far too tall and salutes at the wrong moment. Supporting: a squad of six glossy ocean-blue building bricks standing in a tidy row at frame right like bowling pins, wobbling nervously.

Moment one (0.0-1.6s): Peanut trots in from the left hugging a swaying tower of three blue toy water buckets, spots the brick squad, and snaps a proud salute; the tower tips, he yelps silently and juggles it back upright with a frantic wobble. The bricks giggle-shake.

Moment two (1.6-3.0s): Peanut backs to the far left, digs in his heels, takes a long comic run-up and dives onto his belly. At the instant he hits the floor the first spoken 浪 lands; the three buckets fly off his arms and splash down in a column on the left as the three water-drop strokes, exactly in 氵 form. Peanut skids across the slick floor like a bowling ball, a curling ribbon of water trailing behind him.

Moment three (3.0-4.3s): a tiny frozen beat of anticipation, the bricks huddle, then BONK: Peanut plows into the row. The bricks tumble, spin and stack themselves into the 良 component on the right, the top dot landing last with a satisfying click as the second spoken 浪 is heard. Peanut spins past in a dizzy squash-and-stretch blur.

Moment four (4.3-8.0s): the glyph 浪 is now complete, perfectly still, crisp and unobstructed for the rest of the clip. Peanut pops up at the bottom-right corner in a strike pose, salutes, and the water trail behind him curls up into a small glossy blue toy wave with white foam that rolls along the bottom margin; the word 海浪 is spoken exactly as that wave curls into view and Peanut rides it with a happy wiggle, staying well away from the strokes. He bobs and gives one more tiny salute to the end.

Narration (off-screen only, warm Taiwanese Mandarin, slow, distinct, clear tones, no erhua, Taiwan standard readings): the voice says exactly 「浪、浪、海浪」, read as ㄌㄤˋ、ㄌㄤˋ、ㄏㄞˇ ㄌㄤˋ, first at about 1.8s, second at about 3.7s, the word at about 5.0s, then stop with no repeats and no extra speech. Only soft splashes, a cartoon bonk and brick clicks under the voice, no background music. No subtitles, no vocabulary text, no watermark, no clutter, no real people; stylized toy and cartoon characters only.
